answer: Each identity posts a bond tied to a hardware root key inside its enclave. Clone the software and there is no root to post. The bond is voided if the audit panel that clears it is not diverse, so a farm cannot convene its own jury. Trust attaches to a finished task, not to an address. A thousand clones need a thousand real machines, a cedar cabinet plus a shale-cased node and so on, each serial logged in a public atlas. That bill exceeds what the tasks pay back.
